posts.text:
The way media has completely bought the AI industry’s contention that AI superintelligence is on the horizon and could be a threat to humanity has been frustrating to watch.

Check out my first piece for @zeteo.com where I explain how this is a big distraction and the real threats presented by AI.
posts.summary: Criticizes media for amplifying AI superintelligence hype; identifies other real AI threats
